module.name: Screen Pin
module.description: Capture bounded screen regions into a local pin board.
view.title: Screen Pin
view.subtitle: Capture a region in the Rust backend without filesystem access from the WebView.
view.tip: Coordinates use Windows virtual-screen pixels. Image and pin counts are bounded by the protocol.
status.ready: Ready to capture a screen region.
errors.invalidRegion: The region coordinates or size are invalid.
errors.tooLarge: The capture is too large; reduce the region and retry.
errors.unsupported: Screen capture is only supported on Windows.
